---
title: Blog Posts
listing:
  contents: posts
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  categories: true
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  # Same-height thumbnails (fitted, not cropped, see styles.css), no author
  # line (it's always June), show reading time
  image-height: 150px
  fields: [image, date, title, description, categories, reading-time]
  feed:
    type: full
    items: 1000
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: false
---

```{=html}
<script>
// Old distill category links look like blog.html#category:data_visualization.
// Rewrite them to Quarto's form (#category=data%20visualization) before the listing reads the hash.
if (location.hash.startsWith("#category:")) {
  const cat = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(10)).replace(/_/g, " ");
  history.replaceState(null, "", "#category=" + encodeURIComponent(cat));
}
</script>
```
